prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1169; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the vehicle insured under your policy struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is entitled to compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please inform us of that contact in writing.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the collision, together with a certified copy of the declarations page.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any vehicle or electronic data in your possession or control. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being preserved.
